mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `wms_outbound` WHERE DATE_FORMAT(#{date}, '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m%d')

select * from wms_outbound where bool_delete_enum = 0
and review_status = #{type}
and contain_basic_class & #{ basicClass} > 0
and serial_number like CONCAT('%', #{serialNumber},'%')
and application_SN like CONCAT('%', #{applicationSN},'%')
and create_time >= #{createTime[0]}
and create_time <= #{createTime[1]}
and project_ids is null
and project_ids IS NOT NULL
and find_in_set(#{projectId},project_ids)
-- 判断条件与数据结果是否有交集
and (( outbound_start_time >= #{outboundTime[0]} AND outbound_start_time <= #{outboundTime[1]} ) OR ( outbound_end_time >= #{outboundTime[0]} AND outbound_end_time <= #{outboundTime[1]} ))
and (applicant_name like CONCAT('%', #{operatorName},'%') or reviewer_name like CONCAT('%', #{operatorName},'%') or recipients like CONCAT('%', #{operatorName},'%'))
and bool_scheduling = #{boolScheduling}

select id , serial_number from wms_outbound where bool_delete_enum = 0 and id in
#{id}

select wmod.*, p.id pid, p.short_name psName, p.serial_number pSN, p.name pn, pm.name pmName, pa.name paName, mbf.id mbfId, mbf.name mbfName, ww.id wwId, ww.name wwName, u.name un, wm.measure_unit wmu, wm.measure_precision wmp, wm.accounting_unit wau, wm.accounting_precision wap, batch.name areaBatchName, d.name dn from wms_move_outbound_detail wmod left join contract_project p on p.id = wmod.project_id left join wms_measure wm on wm.classification_id = wmod.classify_id left join mes_building_workshop mbf on wmod.workshop_id = mbf.id left join wms_warehouse ww on ww.id = wmod.warehouse_id left join sys_user as u on u.id = wmod.recipient_id and u.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_department as d on u.department_id = d.id and d.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join plan_monomer pm on pm.id = wmod.monomer_id left join plan_area pa on pa.id = wmod.area_id left join plan_area_batch batch on batch.id = wmod.area_batch_id and batch.bool_delete_enum = 0 where wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wmod.outbound_id = #{id}
select count(id) from wms_outbound where bool_delete_enum = 0 and review_status = #{reviewStatus} and find_in_set(#{projectId},project_ids)
